meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 把纯文本或Markdown文件整理成规范Markdown：自动添加或修正文件头、标题、摘要，用标题层级、粗体、列表、代码块重新排版，并修正中英文间距和引号，最后另存为“原名-formatted.md”。
howto.when: 当你说“格式化 markdown”、“美化文章”等，或要求改进文章排版时触发。

say.text: 帮我格式化这篇文章，输出成规范markdown。
say.note: 会生成一个“原名-formatted.md”的新文件。

say.text: 把这篇纯文本加上标题和列表，保存为格式化文件。
say.note: 会重新排版并另存为新文件。

say.text: 美化一下这个markdown文件的排版，并修正中英文间距。
say.note: 会运行脚本修正排版细节。

howto.what_en: Reformats plain text or Markdown files into well-structured Markdown: adds or fixes frontmatter, title, summary; applies heading levels, bold, lists, code blocks; fixes CJK/English spacing and quotes; saves as '{original-name}-formatted.md'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to 'format markdown', 'beautify article', 'add formatting', or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Please format this article into standard Markdown.
say_en.note: A new file '{name}-formatted.md' will be created.

say_en.text: Add headings and lists to this plain text, save as a formatted file.
say_en.note: It will re-layout and save as a new file.

say_en.text: Beautify this Markdown file's layout and fix CJK/English spacing.
say_en.note: It will run the typography script.
